blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Any survey for the 2028 presidential race including Vice President Sara Duterte may be premature since there is a possibility that she will be permanently barred from holding public office if the Senate Impeachment Court decides to convict her, members of the prosecution panel said Monday. In a press briefing during a break in the impeachment trial, prosecution panel members Manila Rep. Joel Chua and Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr., along with spokesperson and impeachment advisor Robert Ace Barbers agreed that there are a lot of things that could and have happened ever since the Pulse Asia survey conducted last […]...
